This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 993 281 995 257 599 (Right)

(Example: 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
questions.solution:
The given three-digit numbers are: 993, 281, 995, 257, 599.

Now,

The highest number is 995. Its third digit is 5.

The lowest number is 257. Its first digit is 2.

Perform the addition.

Add the third digit of the highest number 5 to the first digit of the lowest number 2.

5 + 2 = 7.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question: If 2 is added to each odd digit and 1 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 2645783, what will be the sum of the highest and lowest digits in the new number thus formed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Original number = 2645783

For each digit in the number:

 
• Add 2 to each odd digit.
 
• Subtract 1 from each even digit.

**Formula Used:**

New digit = Odd digit + 2 (if digit is odd)

New digit = Even digit − 1 (if digit is even)

Sum of the highest and lowest digits = Highest digit in the new number + Lowest digit in the new number

**Calculation:**

Original number = 2, 6, 4, 5, 7, 8, 3

Step 1: Apply the transformation rule:

 
• 2 (even) ⇒ 2 − 1 = 1
 
• 6 (even) ⇒ 6 − 1 = 5
 
• 4 (even) ⇒ 4 − 1 = 3
 
• 5 (odd) ⇒ 5 + 2 = 7
 
• 7 (odd) ⇒ 7 + 2 = 9
 
• 8 (even) ⇒ 8 − 1 = 7
 
• 3 (odd) ⇒ 3 + 2 = 5

New number = 1, 5, 3, 7, 9, 7, 5

Step 2: Find the highest and lowest digits:

 
• Highest digit = 9
 
• Lowest digit = 1

Step 3: Calculate the sum of the highest and lowest digits:

⇒ Sum = 9 + 1

⇒ Sum = 10

**The sum of the highest and lowest digits in the new number is 10.**
